resources.string: All required capabilities are ready. Tap to re-run the wizard.
%1$d capability missing. Tap to review and reconfigure.
Status: no runtime grant required on this Android version
Status: not supported on this Android version
Status: turned off in system settings
Used to show reminders and status updates from this plugin. On Android 13 and later this is a runtime permission requested with the system dialog.
If you skip this, the database, parsers and Smartspacer target still work. Reminders simply will not appear as notifications. You can enable notifications later from the settings page.
Used only to automatically parse incoming SMS for this plugin. The system permission dialog is shown after this explanation — it is never requested as a silent batch with other special permissions.
If you skip this, automatic SMS parsing is turned off. Share-sheet parsing, manual paste and every other non-SMS feature stay available.
Used to scan existing conversations when you choose to import history. Requested only after this explanation, never together with special (non-runtime) permissions.
If you skip this, inbox scanning is unavailable. Share-sheet parsing, manual paste and other non-SMS features stay available.
Used to fire time-sensitive reminders on schedule. This is a special permission — the wizard opens the system exact-alarm screen instead of a runtime permission dialog.
If you skip this, reminders are still scheduled with an inexact fallback (`setAndAllowWhileIdle`), so they may fire a few minutes off. They are never silently dropped.

Used only for ongoing, user-initiated, time-sensitive Live Updates. `POST_PROMOTED_NOTIFICATIONS` is a manifest permission, not a runtime dialog. On Android 16 QPR1 (36.1) and later you can enable the per-app toggle in system settings.
If Live Updates are unavailable, this plugin still posts a normal ongoing notification. Static reminders are never upgraded just to request this capability.
